content.text: No liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination fee payable by Customer appears anywhere in the agreement.

input.quote: After thirty consecutive days, Customer may terminate the affected Order Form without penalty and receive a refund of prepaid Fees for the unavailable period.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum fee payable by Customer. Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "early termination" and "shall pay" return only Section 7.1 (ordinary Fees), Section 22.2 (audit costs on a >5% underpayment, a cost-shifting mechanic rather than an LD), and Section 27.3, which expressly lets Customer terminate "without penalty". The termination provisions (Sections 9 and 10) impose no exit charge and in fact require Vendor refunds of prepaid Fees. This meets the preferred position, so no redline. Noted but not flagged here: the Section 2.1 take-or-pay commitment of USD 2,000,000 per year "without reduction or termination rights" is the closest economic exposure, but it is a minimum-volume commitment addressed under the minimum-commitment rule, not a liquidated damages clause, and we do not flag the same commercial term twice. Also noted: the service-level exhibit referenced in Section 2.2 is not in this document, so we cannot confirm service credits run in our favour.
